_ghi_chu: SAU CUA DU AN NAY MUON CO. Day la BAN KHAI, khong phai noi dang ky.
Claude Code KHONG doc file nay. Noi dang ky that la ~/.claude/settings.json,
bang duong dan TUYET DOI, va do la noi duy nhat sau cua nay thuc su chay.
Truoc do sau hook nay nam trong <repo>/.claude/settings.json. File ay chi
duoc nap khi thu muc du an cua phien LA repo. Do truc tiep lan dau bang mot
phien `claude -p` chay voi cwd dat o repo: settings cua repo CO nap that,
va khi do CA HAI file cung nap nen MOI HOOK CHAY HAI LAN. Hai ban ghi
hook_success rieng biet cho SessionStart, phan biet duoc bang statusMessage.
Chay doi khong nguy hiem nhung ton, va no lam hong mot thu dang dung lam
bang chung: nhat ky cua_doc_bat_buoc bi nhan doi. Vi sau hook da co ban
toan cuc, ban trong repo khong mang lai chuc nang nao va chi mang mot moi
nguy -- nen no duoc go di, va phan khai bao chuyen sang day.
tools/kiem_cua_song.py doc file nay roi so voi ~/.claude/settings.json.
Tren mot may moi, no se bao 0/6 -- dung thong diep can co: hay chep sau
hook nay sang settings toan cuc bang duong dan tuyet doi.
Giu nguyen hinh dang cua settings.json de cong cu doc chung mot ham.
